transport.einstieg: Select a route or depot to inspect causes, consequences and remedies.
transport.keinEngpass: No major route disruptions. Check regional warehouses for goods shortages.
transport.keinDepot: An operation creates a front depot. It starts empty and must receive existing supplies.
transport.folgenRoute: Blocked shipments seek alternate routes. If capacity is insufficient, goods remain at their source. Civilian regions and front depots then draw on their stocks.
transport.feindHinweis: An enemy advance blocks this land route. Repairs cannot reopen it. Use another route, a limited airlift or end the fighting.
transport.frontFolge: Supply factor on this front: {kraft}% of otherwise available combat strength. Fuel shortages weaken this operation, not every war equally.
transport.depotBilanz: Last balance (million t): {anfang} stock + {lieferung} delivered − {verbrauch} consumed = {ende}.
transport.region: This hub serves {n} provinces. Demand coverage in the last settled month:
transport.regionFolge: Shortfalls affect prices and supply in these provinces. Energy and input shortages then slow production. An open route does not create additional goods.
transport.modell: Strategic corridors and regional stocks, not surveyed alignments. Capacities are game parameters. Quantities and effects settle monthly.
transport.keinUmweg: No open alternate route. Check the front depots or end the fighting.
transport.auftrag: {name} ordered. Takes effect after at least {tage} days.
transport.wirkung.reparatur: Repairs 65 percentage points of damage after 14 days. Continued fighting can cause new damage.
transport.wirkung.umleitung: Organises an open detour: 50% extra capacity there for 90 days, starting after 7 days. All goods share it.
transport.wirkung.luftbruecke: Limited supply directly from Ankara for 60 days. Bypasses blocked land routes but cannot replace full supply. Requires existing fuel.
transport.wirkung.depot: Increases the target stock after 21 days. The depot must then receive existing goods over available routes.
karte.kurz.versorgung: Regional goods flows, disrupted corridors and front depots.
transport.karteHinweis: Select a corridor or depot. Every connection matters.
transport.frontKurz: Fuel shortages weaken this front. Restore its supply.
transport.frontGut: Operational needs are met. Keep access routes open.
transport.feindKurz: Enemy forces block the route. Repairs alone cannot reopen it.
